cases.name: Lacie Moore
cases.about: She was a teacher at Davis Intermediate School in Wylie. School Principal Cody Summers sent a letter to parents on Monday asking for people to keep the family in their thoughts and prayers. "Mrs. Moore was a bright light and a beloved member of our Davis family," Summers said.
